parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds in document CHEMBL1126835. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126835'. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
